_about: Ocean fishing: the voyage rotation is the game's own IKDRouteTable (144 voyages, Indigo and Ruby columns); a voyage leaves every 2 hours on the even UTC hour, and the voyage leaving at Unix time t (seconds) uses row ((t / 7200) + 40) mod 144. The offset was checked against the community schedule at ffxiv.oceanfishing.boats (its 144-voyage pattern matches the game table exactly at this offset for both routes). Each route's best targets (fabled fish and mission families) are facts from that site; stops, times of day and fish come from the game sheets.
